verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              सोऽज्ञापयत संरब्धः सचिवानात्मनोहितान्। यत्ता भवत सर्वे वै देवक्या गर्भकृन्तने॥१॥
verses.english: As his work of creation did not continue smoothly, one prajApati from the batch of seven marIchi et al prajApati-s, named vashiSTHa, whose another name is आपव, तस्य आपवस्य वशिSट्ःअ अपर नाम्नः प्रजापतेः, bifurcated his body to become the pair of male and female. The female principle of this prajApati is called शत-रूप. Thus शत-रूप took birth from a non-vaginal source, and created both male and female entities of diverse forms; नारी यद् यद् रूपम्, गो, वडवादिकम् गृहीतवती, तत् तत् जातीयम् वृष, अश्व आदि रूपम्, पुरुषो अपि गृहीतवान् - whichever feminal form shata-rUpa assumed, like cows, mares etc., the male half of आपव प्रजापति, नमेल्य् स्वायम्भू मनु, assumed the male form of that kind, say oxen, horses etc., in order to further that kind of species. prajApati आपव, that is to say, the male half of Apava, namely स्वायम्भू मनु continued the biogenesis of diverse biogenic beings through शत-रूप तेन, शतरूपेन मैथुन्य जा प्रजाः विविधाः ससृजे इति अर्थः, and thus, he stayed pervading earth and sky with his efficacy.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमादेव हन्तव्या गर्भास्ते सप्त एव हि। मूलादेव तु हन्तव्यः सोऽनर्थो यत्र संशयः॥२॥
verses.english: Then, oh, king, swayambhu manu, or Apava prajApati stayed encompassing the firmament by virtue of his yogic power, and his wife designate shata-rUpa manifested herself diversely by the dint of svayambhu's yogic power.
verses.bhavadeepa: अस्मिन्द्वितीये ह्यध्याये कंसस्याकुलतोच्यते। विष्णुना योगमायायै देवकार्यानुशासनम्॥१॥ आज्ञापयत आज्ञापितवान्। संरब्धः क्रुद्धः॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: देवकी च गृहे गुप्ता प्रच्छन्नैरभिरक्षिता। स्वैरं चरतु विश्रब्धा गर्भकाले तु रक्ष्यताम्॥३॥
verses.english: And from those females and respective males, gods, birds, serpents, cows, daitya-dAnava-gadharvA-s, apsara-s have emerged, besides a host of other living beings of diverse species.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रथमात् प्रथमं जन्मदिनं प्राप्येत्यर्थः। सोऽष्टमो मूलाद्गर्भधारणादेवौषधाद्यैरुपायैर्हन्तव्य इत्यर्थः॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: मासान्वै पुष्पमासादीन्गणयन्तु मम स्त्रियः। परिणामे तु गर्भस्य शेषं ज्ञास्यामहे वयम्॥४॥
verses.english: Thus that Apava prajApati alone is called swAyambhuva manu oh, sire, janamejaya, a time-cycle consisting seventy one yuga-s, eras, is named after him, known as a manvantaram

verses.sanskrit: वसुदेवस्तु संरक्ष्यः स्त्रीसनाथासु भूमिषु। अप्रमत्तैर्मम हितै रात्रावहनि चैव हि। स्त्रीभिर्वर्षवरैश्चैव वक्तव्यं न तु कारणम्॥५॥
verses.english: In ten thousand years trees mushroomed overhead, and air ceased to circulate, whereupon living-beings are rendered inanimate.

verses.sanskrit: एष मानुष्यको यत्नो मानुषैरेव साध्यते। श्रूयतां येन दैवं हि मद्विधैः प्रतिहन्यते॥६॥
verses.english: There is another damsel named kAmya who is the daughter of kardama prajApati. This girl on taking प्रियव्रत as her husband gave rise to four sons called साम्राट्, कुक्शि, विराट्, and prabhu - thus वीर has six sons in total.
verses.bhavadeepa: स्त्रीसनाथासु अन्तःपुरभूमिषु वर्षवरैः नपुंसकैः वसुदेवसन्निधौ प्रसवे सति स गर्भमन्यत्र मा नयत्वित्येतदर्थं सोऽपि रक्ष्य इत्यर्थः॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रग्रामैः सुविहितैरौषधैश्च सुयोजितैः। यत्नेन चानुकूलेन दैवमप्यनुलोम्यते॥७॥
verses.english: Then prajApati अत्रि adopted उत्तानपद as his son, and uttAnapAda begot four sons from a damsel called सूनृत, or also called as सुनीत.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवं स यत्नवान्कंसो देवकीगर्भकृन्तने। भयेन मन्त्रयामास श्रुतार्थो नारदात्स वै॥८॥
verses.english: This curvaceous damsel well-known as सूनृत is the daughter of धर्म. That is to say, this girl actually emerged from the horse-ritual of dharma, hence she is the daughter of dharma, and she is the auspicious mother of ध्रुव, too. uttAnapAda-prajApati begot four sons through this सूनृत, who are ध्रुव, कीर्ति-मन्त, a calm-and-collected boy शिव, and अयस्पति.

verses.sanskrit: एवं श्रुत्वा प्रयत्नं वै कंसस्यारिष्टसंज्ञितम्। अन्तर्धानं गतो विष्णूश्चिन्तयामास वीर्यवान्॥९॥
verses.english: Then prajApati अत्रि adopted उत्तानपद as his son, and uttAnapAda begot four sons from a damsel called सूनृत, or also called as सुनीत.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तेमान्देवकीगर्भान्भोजपुत्रो वधिष्यति। अष्टमे च मया गर्भे कार्यमाधानमात्मनः॥१०॥
verses.english: And lady sAvarNI gave rise to ten sons of prAchIna-barhi, where those ten sons are called by a single collective name - प्राचेतस-s, who are experts in missile-archery.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चिन्तयतस्त्वेवं पातालमगमन्मनः। यत्र ते गर्भशयनाः षड्गर्भा नाम दानवाः॥११॥
verses.english: And oh, bharata, dhruva undertook ascesis for three thousand divine years, praying for the grace of most glorious almighty. Pleased with his ascesis, brahma, the foremost prajApati, bestowed upon him a nonpareil and changeless station in the vault of heaven loftier than that of seven-sages constellation, Ursa Major. This is called ध्रुव मण्डल - sphere of North Star.

verses.sanskrit: विक्रान्तवपुषो दीप्तास्तेऽमृतप्राशनोपमाः। अमरप्रतिमा युद्धे पुत्रा वै कालनेमिनः॥१२॥
verses.english: Observing the remarkable achievement and efficacy of ascesis of dhruva, the mentor of gods and demons, namely शुक्र-आचार्य, sung a verse in his honour 'what a rigour in ascesis what knowledge in scriptures what a resolvedness this dhruva has whereby the seven-sages are standing there keeping him in their van'
verses.bhavadeepa: गर्भशयनाः जलगर्भशायिनः षड्गर्भा नामतः नाम्ना। “हंसः सुविक्रमः क्राथो दमनो रिपुमर्दनः। क्रोधहन्तेति विख्याताः षड्गर्भा नाम दानवाः॥” इति पुराणप्रसिद्धाः॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: ते ताततातं सन्त्यज्य हिरण्यकशिपुं पुरा। उपासाञ्चक्रिरे दैत्याः पुरा लोकपितामहम्॥१३॥
verses.english: ध्रुव begot two sons, named श्लिष्टि and भव्य, from his wife, namely lady शम्भु. And shliShTi begot five blemishless sons, namely रिपु, रिपुन्-जय, पुण्य, वृक्ल, वृक-तेज from his wife named सु-cछाया।

verses.sanskrit: तप्यमानास्तपस्तीव्रं जटामण्डलधारिणः। तेषां प्रीतोऽभवद्ब्रह्मा षड्गर्भाणां वरं ददौ॥१४॥
verses.english: And from रिपु his wife named बृहति gave rise to most effulgent son named चाक्शुष.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मोवाच।
              भो भो दानवशार्दूलास्तपसाहं सुतोषितः। ब्रूत वो यस्य यः कामस्तस्य तं तं करोम्यहम्॥१५॥
verses.english: There emerged a son, called मनु, to this chAkshuSha through his wife named पुष्करिणि, the daughter of वीरण.

verses.sanskrit: ते तु सर्वे समानार्था दैत्या ब्रह्माणमब्रुवन्। यदि नो भगवान्प्रीतो दीयतां नो वरो वरः॥१६॥
verses.english: Then, pracetasA-s on listening to the words of soma, the moon, controlled their anger towards trees, and took mAriSha as their collective wife, ritually.

verses.sanskrit: अवध्याः स्याम भगवन्देवतैः समहोरगैः। शापप्रहरणैश्चैवं स्वस्ति नोऽस्तु महर्षिभिः॥१७॥
verses.english: "This girl, a jewel among beauties, is the daughter of vegetation, and as I am aware of the futurity I have contained and nurtured her in my womb

verses.sanskrit: यक्षगन्धर्वपतिभिस्सिद्धचारणमानवैः। मा भूद्वधो नो भगवन्ददासि यदि नो वरम्॥१८॥
verses.english: From Uru, the daughter of agni, namely lady आग्नेयि, gave rise to six highly brilliant sons, and they are - अन्ग, सुमन, ख्याति, क्रतु, अन्गीइरस, and गय.

verses.sanskrit: तानुवाच ततो ब्रह्मा सुप्रीतेनान्तरात्मना। भवद्भिर्यदिदं प्रोक्तं सर्वमेतद्भविष्यति॥१९॥
verses.english: ऊरु, पुरु, शत-द्युम्न, तपस्वि, सत्यवान्, कवि, अग्नि-ष्टुत, अति-रात्र, and सुद्युम्न - these are nine, and the tenth one is अभिमन्यु; these are renowned as the sons of lady naDwala.

verses.sanskrit: षड्गर्भाणां वरं दत्वा स्वयम्भूस्त्रिदिवं गतः। ततो हिरण्यकशिपुः सरोषो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥२०॥
verses.english: But the sages put vena's arms to friction with a view to obtain his progeny, and while sages are thus chafing, there emerged emperor पृथु, from the right palm of vena.

verses.sanskrit: मामुत्सृज्य वरो यस्माद्वृतो वः पद्मसम्भवात्। तस्माद्वस्त्याजितः स्नेहः शत्रुभूतांस्त्यजाम्यहम्॥२१॥
verses.english: On seeing pR^ithu, the sages have said in certainty that, "this highly resplendent boy, namely pR^ithu, will acquire fame and renown, and he will make people happy"

verses.sanskrit: षड्गर्भा इति योऽयं वः शब्दः पित्राभिवर्धितः। स एव वो गर्भगतान्पिता सर्वान्वधिष्यति॥२२॥
verses.english: As if to burn down adversaries, this earliest kshatriya pR^ithu wielded bow, armour and sword, whereby he safeguarded this earth.

verses.sanskrit: षडेव देवकीगर्भाः षड्गर्भा वै महासुराः। भविष्यथ ततः कंसो गर्भस्थान्वो वधिष्यति॥२३॥
verses.english: And pR^ithu is the foremost among the kings that are re-anointed through rAjasUya ritual, and there emerged सूत-s, the balladeers, who sing the glory of kings; and मागधा-s, the minstrels, who sing the praise of the dynasties of kings, from the ritual fire of pR^ithu's rAjasUya ritual.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              जगामाथ ततो विष्णुः पातालं यत्र तेऽसुराः। षड्गर्भाः संयताः सन्ति जले गर्भगृहेशयाः॥२४॥
verses.english: And pR^ithu is the foremost among the kings that are re-anointed through rAjasUya ritual, and there emerged सूत-s, the balladeers, who sing the glory of kings; and मागधा-s, the minstrels, who sing the praise of the dynasties of kings, from the ritual fire of pR^ithu's rAjasUya ritual.

verses.sanskrit: सन्ददर्श जले सुप्तान्षड्गर्भान्गर्भसंस्थितान्। निद्रया कालरूपिण्या सर्वानन्तर्हितान्त्स वै॥२५॥
verses.english: And that lord daksha gave ten of those females to धर्म; thirteen to कश्यप prajApati; and the remaining ones, twenty-seven of them, to the king सोम, namely moon, since those twenty-seven females bear the names of constellations like अश्विनि, भरणि, कृत्तिक etc.  their progeny arundhati earth with all her paraphenalia earth with all her paraphenalia vasu eight vasu-s - bhIShma is one of them in earlier birth eight vasu-s - bhIShma is one of them in earlier birth yAmi / jAmi presiding deity of thick forest presiding deity of thick forest langha / lamba ghoSha / vidyota ghoSha / vidyota bhAnu bhAnu-s bhAnu-s marudvati marutvanta; jayanta marutvanta; jayanta samkalpa samkalpa-s - the volition to do anything positive samkalpa-s - the volition to do anything positive muhUrta mauhIrtika-s mauhIrtika-s sAdhya sAdhyA-s sAdhyA-s vishva vishve-devA-s vishve-devA-s   their progeny   1. diti daityA-s daityA-s 2. aditi AdityA-s AdityA-s 3. danu dAnavA-s dAnavA-s 4. anAyu, or anuaga siddhA-s siddhA-s 5. prAtha gandharvA-s gandharvA-s 6. muni apsarasa-s, and gandharvA-s called mAneyA-s apsarasa-s, and gandharvA-s called mAneyA-s 7. surasa yakshA-s, rAkshasA-s yakshA-s, rAkshasA-s 8. ila vR^iksha, latA, tR^iNa - trees, plants, creepers - all flora vR^iksha, latA, tR^iNa - trees, plants, creepers - all flora 9. krodhavasha lions, tigers - all carnivorous fauna lions, tigers - all carnivorous fauna 10. tAmra avians like eagles, birds, and horses, asses, camels etc avians like eagles, birds, and horses, asses, camels etc 11. kapila, or, surabhi go gaNa - cows and cattle go gaNa - cows and cattle 12. vinata anUru, garuDa anUru, garuDa 13. kadruva reptiles reptiles

verses.sanskrit: स्वप्नरूपेण तेषां वै विष्णुर्देहानथाविशत्। प्राणेश्वरांश्च निष्कृष्य निद्रायै प्रददौ तदा॥२६॥
verses.english: When the assemblages of manes, दानवा-स्, गन्धर्वा-स्, अप्सर-स्, रेप्तिलेस्, यक्श-स् [पुण्य जन], together with trees and mountains have taken up milking vessels and milked cowlike earth, earth has given milk / produce according as their requirement, and all of them felt that their livelihood is unhindered. That is to say, pR^ithu met with all the requirements of earthlings by propitiating mother earth.

verses.sanskrit: तां चोवाच ततो निद्रां विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः। गच्छ निद्रे मयोत्सृष्टा देवकीभवनान्तिकम्॥२७॥
verses.english: When the assemblages of manes, दानवा-स्, गन्धर्वा-स्, अप्सर-स्, रेप्तिलेस्, यक्श-स् [पुण्य जन], together with trees and mountains have taken up milking vessels and milked cowlike earth, earth has given milk / produce according as their requirement, and all of them felt that their livelihood is unhindered. That is to say, pR^ithu met with all the requirements of earthlings by propitiating mother earth.
verses.bhavadeepa: स्वप्नेति। ब्रह्मवरदानादविनष्टस्थूलदेहानामेव तेषां विष्णुमायाबलेन स्वप्नवज्जन्मान्तरप्रतिभासो हिरण्यकशिपुशापनिमित्तो लवणस्येव जात इत्यर्थः। प्राणेश्वरान् जीवान्। नन्वेवं स्वदेहाद्बहिर्गतैः पुरुषैर्देशान्तरे स्वप्नप्रपञ्चो जाग्रद्वत्सत्यत एव प्रतीयत इति दर्शितम्। तेन अस्मद्दृष्ट्या षङ्गर्भाणां जन्म योगमायाकृतत्वादिन्द्रजालपुरवत् व्यावहारिकम्। षङ्गर्भदृष्ट्या तु स्वप्नवत्प्रातिभासिकमिति सिद्धेर्न कश्चिद्दोषः॥२६॥

verses.sanskrit: इमान्प्राणेश्वरान्गृह्य षड्गर्भान्दानवोत्तमान्। सर्वप्राणेश्वरांश्चैव षड्गर्भान्नाम देहिनः। षड्गर्भान्देवकीगर्भे योजयस्व यथाक्रमम्॥२८॥
verses.english: pR^ithu had two virtuous sons, namely अन्तर्-धी and पालित, and अन्तर्धी begot a son named हविधान from his wife named lady शिखण्डिनि.

verses.sanskrit: जातेष्वेतेषु गर्भेषु नीतेषु च यमक्षयम्। कंसस्य विफले यत्ने देवक्याः सफले श्रमे॥२९॥
verses.english: "All of you, oh, prAchetasa-kings, may please leave off your fury oh, sons of prAchIna-brahi you have almost bared the earth of her trees now let the blazing fire and eroding air surcease" So started soma to advice prAchetasa-s...

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादं ते करिष्यामि मत्प्रभावसमं भुवि। येन सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवि देवी भविष्यसि॥३०॥
verses.english: Oh, janamejaya, when the sacred grass is spread on earth with their tips pointing to east in his vedic-rituals, that grass looked like sprawling on whole of the earth, indicating the wideness of his sway on earth, and hence he is known as godly prAchIna-brahi.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तमो देवकीगर्भो योऽंशः सौम्यो ममाग्रजः। स सङ्क्रामयितव्यस्ते सप्तमे मासि रोहिणीम्॥३१॥
verses.english: And after a long lasting ascesis that lord and king prAchIna-barhi married the daughter of ocean, namely lady सावर्णि.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्कर्षणात्तु गर्भस्य स तु सङ्कर्षणो युवा। भविष्यत्यग्रजो भ्राता मम शीतांशुदर्शनः॥३२॥
verses.english: That fraternity of ten have a common school in duty and action, and at certain time they undertook a rigorous ascesis for ten thousand years submersed in oceanic water.
verses.bhavadeepa: सप्तम इति। सप्तमस्य गर्भस्य यद्यपि प्रसवे जीवनमविरुद्धं तथापि रोहिण्युदरे प्रवेशस्तस्यां गर्भसङ्क्रमश्च मायाबलादेवेति ज्ञेयम्॥३१॥

verses.sanskrit: पतितो देवकीगर्भः सप्तमोऽयं भयादिति। अष्टमे मयि गर्भस्थे कंसो यत्नं करिष्यति॥३३॥
verses.english: That fraternity of ten have a common school in duty and action, and at certain time they undertook a rigorous ascesis for ten thousand years submersed in oceanic water.

verses.sanskrit: या तु सा नन्दगोपस्य दयिता भुवि विश्रुता। यशोदा नाम भद्रं ते भार्या गोपकुलोद्वहा॥३४॥
verses.english: And when those ten brothers are deep in their ascesis, then the earth has become unprotected because she lacked a protector, whereby the overspread of trees on earth has become so thick that the earth is unventilated, whereof people started to perish.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्त्वं नवमो गर्भः कुलेऽस्माकं भविष्यसि। नवम्यामेव सञ्जाता कृष्णपक्षस्य वै तिथौ॥३५॥
verses.english: In ten thousand years trees mushroomed overhead, and air ceased to circulate, whereupon living-beings are rendered inanimate.

verses.sanskrit: अहं त्वभिजितो योगे निशायां यौवने स्थिते। अर्धरात्रे करिष्यामि गर्भमोक्षं यथासुखम्॥३६॥
verses.english: On noticing this situation with an ascetic intuition, all the ten prAchetasa-s furiously vented air as well as fire from their faces.
verses.bhavadeepa: नवमत्वं कृष्णमनु तस्या अपि देवक्युदरे स्वल्पकालं प्रवेशोऽस्तीति सिद्ध्यति। नवम्यामिति त्वष्टम्यां कृष्णजन्म तदनन्तरं देव्या इति युक्तम्। एकस्यामपि रात्रौ तात्कालिकतिथिभेदसम्भवात्॥३५॥

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमस्य तु मासस्य जातावावां ततः समम्। प्राप्स्यावो गर्भव्यत्यासं प्राप्ते कंसस्य नाशने॥३७॥
verses.english: On noticing this situation with an ascetic intuition, all the ten prAchetasa-s furiously vented air as well as fire from their faces.

verses.sanskrit: अहं यशोदां यास्यामि त्वं देवि भज देवकीम्। आवयोर्गर्भसंयोगे कंसो गच्छतु मूढताम्॥३८॥
verses.english: Noticing the near-extinction of trees in a non-stop manner, the king of vegetation, namely सोम, or chandra - the presiding deity of the moon, also called rAja, the king, approached the ten prAchetasa brothers and spoke to them in this way.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वां गृह्य चरणे शिलायां पातयिष्यति। निरस्यमाना गगने स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्॥३९॥
verses.english: Noticing the near-extinction of trees in a non-stop manner, the king of vegetation, namely सोम, or chandra - the presiding deity of the moon, also called rAja, the king, approached the ten prAchetasa brothers and spoke to them in this way.

verses.sanskrit: मच्छवीसदृशी कृष्णा सङ्कर्षणसमानना। बिभ्रती विपुलौ बाहू मम बाहूपमौ दिवि॥४०॥
verses.english: "This girl, a jewel among beauties, is the daughter of vegetation, and as I am aware of the futurity I have contained and nurtured her in my womb

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशिखं शूलमुद्यम्य खड्गं च कनकत्सरुम्। पात्रीं च पूर्णां मधुना पङ्कजं च सुनिर्मलम्॥४१॥
verses.english: "She who is formulated by vegetation is मारिष by her name, and oh, high-minded prachetA-s, she being the augmenter of lunar dynasty, you accept her as your wife

verses.sanskrit: नीलकौशेयसंवीता पीतेनोत्तरवाससा। शशिरश्मिप्रकाशेन हारेणोरसि राजता॥४२॥
verses.english: "She who is formulated by vegetation is मारिष by her name, and oh, high-minded prachetA-s, she being the augmenter of lunar dynasty, you accept her as your wife

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यकुण्डलपूर्णाभ्यां श्रवणाभ्यां विभूषिता। चन्द्रसापत्नभूतेन मुखेन त्वं विराजिता॥४३॥
verses.english: Then, pracetasA-s on listening to the words of soma, the moon, controlled their anger towards trees, and took mAriSha as their collective wife, ritually.

verses.sanskrit: मुकुटेन विचित्रेण केशबन्धेन शोभिना। भुजङ्गाभैर्भुजैर्भीमैर्भूषयन्ती दिशो दश॥४४॥
verses.english: Then, oh, king janamejaya, all the ten prAcetasA-s have astrally impregnated mAriSha, and through her they begot a highly resplendent prajApati named दक्श, who emerged with a shade of anima of soma, the moon

verses.sanskrit: ध्वजेन शिखिबर्हेण उच्छ्रितेन विराजिता। अङ्गजेन मयूराणामङ्गदेन च भास्वता॥४५॥
verses.english: Later, daksha prajApati started to bring forth those living beings that can augment the kindred of moon. He also brought forth sessile, mobile, bipeds, and quadrupeds. And then he devised females, on envisioning the need for the recipient of seed.

verses.sanskrit: कीर्णा भूतगणैर्घोरैर्मन्नियोगानुवर्तिनी। कौमारं व्रतमास्थाय त्रिदिवं त्वं गमिष्यसि॥४६॥
तत्र त्वां शतदृक्छक्रो मत्प्रदिष्टेन कर्मणा। अभिषेकेण दिव्येन देवतैः सह योक्ष्यसे॥४७॥
verses.english: Later, daksha prajApati started to bring forth those living beings that can augment the kindred of moon. He also brought forth sessile, mobile, bipeds, and quadrupeds. And then he devised females, on envisioning the need for the recipient of seed.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैव त्वां भगिन्यर्थे ग्रहीष्यति स वासवः। कुशिकस्य तु गोत्रेण कौशिकी त्वं भविष्यसि॥४८॥
verses.english: From then on, the biogenetic creation prospered, whereas creation earlier to this is just based on volition, sight and touch - सम्कल्प, दर्शन, स्पर्श

verses.sanskrit: स ते विन्ध्ये नगश्रेष्ठे स्थानं दास्यति शाश्वतम्। ततः स्थानसहस्रैस्त्वं पृथिवीं शोभयिष्यसि॥४९॥
त्रैलोक्यचारिणी सा त्वं भुवि सत्योपयाचना। चरिष्यसि महाभागे वरदा कामरूपिणी॥५०॥
तत्र शुम्भनिशुम्भौ द्वौ दानवौ नगचारिणौ। तौ च कृत्वा मनसि मां सानुगौ नाशयिष्यसि॥५१॥
verses.english: "Oh, king, birth and death are consecutive factors to living beings scholars and sages are not deluded by them and oh, king, these daksha and others come to being and depart, era after era, for which scholars are not intrigued likewise, who is first and who is next - is also not reckoned earlier ascesis and its impact used to be the main criterion thus, oh, king, whoever comes to know that the creation of sessile and mobile universe is owing to daksha prajApati, he will flourish with a vast family as long as he is on earth, and attain heaven at the end of it
verses.bhavadeepa: सत्या अवश्यफला उपयाचना ममेदम् ईप्सितं कुरु अहं त्वां पूजयिष्यामीत्येवंरूपा प्रार्थना सत्या उपयाचना यस्यां सा तथा॥५०॥

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वानुयात्रां भूतस्त्वं सुरामांसबलिप्रिया। तिथौ नवम्यां पूजां त्वं प्राप्स्यसे सपशुक्रियाम्॥५२॥
ये च त्वां मत्प्रभावज्ञाः प्रणमिष्यन्ति मानवाः। तेषां न दुर्लभं किञ्चित्पुत्रतो धनतोऽपि वा॥५३॥
verses.english: "Oh, sage, earlier you have narrated about the generation of deva-dAnava-gandharva-rAksha-s by the noble souled daksha and oh, blemishless sage, you yourself have said that daksha has emerged from the right thumb of brahma, and his wife from the left thumb but how daksha has emerged as the son of prachetasA-s once again; and how daksha being the grandson of soma, the moon, has become a father-in-law of that soma these are my doubts and, oh, brahmaNa, it will be apt of you to clear this doubt of mine

verses.sanskrit: कान्तारेष्ववसन्नानां मग्नानां च महार्णवे। दस्युभिर्वा निरुद्धानां त्वं गतिः परमा नृणाम्॥५४॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the second chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the the emergence of daksha-prajApati.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां तु स्तोष्यन्ति ये भक्त्या स्तवेनानेन वै शुभे। तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति॥५५॥
